title: What's new in v2.8.0
summary: Network Optimizer can read Wi-Fi data from your access points directly now, providing live client data twice a second, real-time roaming data and AP / band switching while walk testing, and per-client Wi-Fi throughput UniFi Network never showed.

steps.title: AP Telemetry
steps.listLabel: Read Wi-Fi data straight from your access points
steps.body:
Read Wi-Fi data from the access points themselves instead of only from the UniFi Console: faster live client data, per-client LAN throughput, roam records, and radio health. Switch it on and a small ephemeral agent is pushed to each access point over SSH.

More performance, analysis, and recommendation features built on this data are coming soon.

steps.title: Client Performance
steps.listLabel: Live client data twice a second, and it keeps up through a roam
steps.body: With **AP Telemetry** on, this page reads the client's AP data twice a second. Signal, PHY rates, and throughput move as fast as the client does, and when it roams the stats follow to the new AP immediately instead of stalling.

steps.title: Roam
steps.listLabel: Move your client to the next AP while walk testing or troubleshooting
steps.body: **Roam** asks a client to move to the nearest AP besides the current one, or to a more optimal band. Useful on a walk test, when you need the device on the access point you are testing rather than wherever it is clinging.

steps.title: Live View
steps.listLabel: See Wi-Fi LAN traffic your Console never counted
steps.body: UniFi Network only counts WAN traffic per client, so a client copying to a NAS, streaming from your media server, or running a LAN speed test read as idle. Reading AP stats directly lets this view display and record actual Wi-Fi traffic on the air, so you can review and investigate traffic patterns later.
